# Hunky Butler Service

> UK hen party entertainment company supplying buff butlers, life drawing, male strippers and cocktail classes. Based in Liverpool city centre and covering cities across England, Scotland and Wales.

Hunky Butler Service provides male entertainment for hen parties, birthdays, corporate events and private celebrations. Bookings are made online through an instant quote, secured with a 20 pound deposit or paid in full. Travel is calculated automatically from the customer's nearest staffing hub, so central city addresses cost less than rural ones. Services can be combined in a single booking and more than one of any service can be booked.

## Services

- [Buff Butlers](https://www.hunkybutlerservice.co.uk/buff-butlers): Topless butlers who welcome guests, serve drinks, run party games and host the event. Two hour bookings as standard.
- [Life Drawing](https://www.hunkybutlerservice.co.uk/life-drawing): Ninety minute sessions, usually split between drawing and butler service. All paper, pencils and boards supplied. The male model stays on afterwards as a buff butler.
- [Male Strippers](https://www.hunkybutlerservice.co.uk/strippers): A ten to fifteen minute routine performed in a private space such as an apartment or booked function room. Performers arrive discreetly in plain clothes.
- [Cocktail Classes](https://www.hunkybutlerservice.co.uk/cocktail): Mobile cocktail making brought to your accommodation. Three cocktails per person, with all spirits, mixers, glassware and equipment provided. Minimum group size eight.
- [All services](https://www.hunkybutlerservice.co.uk/party-entertainment-services)
